claycode.delta: Keep current capability semantics; add proof-carrying GateExecutionReceipt/admission infrastructure for runtime/ABI/FFI gates. Bind exact runtime, validation, invocation/workflow, semantic inputs and execution scope. Do not add core syntax without an executable counterexample.

harness.delta: Harness may only treat a gate as executed/verified when an exact subject/material/scope-bound receipt is verified. Workflow presence, queued work or commit wording are not execution evidence.

frank.delta: Frank's effect authority remains live runtime capability possession; build/test attestations are evidence objects only. FRANK/H2/H3 admission must never let attestation/provenance substitute for capability authority or vice versa.

unifieddb.delta: Persist gate transitions append-only with evidence refs and immutable subject/material identities; preserve DEFINED, QUEUED, RUNNING, EXECUTED, VERIFIED and ADMITTED as distinct states.

claygraph.delta: Graph may index receipt/material/run relations for retrieval; graph activation or agreement never promotes gate truth.

gwt.delta: If gate evidence enters workspace competition, broadcast/relevance remains distinct from verification/admission and effect authority.

hyperposition.delta: Unknown/multiple possible gate states remain explicit until receipt verification; uncertainty is not collapsed to PASS.

emergenz.delta: Causal/replay comparisons should bind exact executable/harness/test identities and scope so software-version drift cannot masquerade as an emergence/intervention effect.

clayresearch.delta: Make authority, provenance, execution evidence, truth and release admission orthogonal in the shared semantic fabric; this reduces cross-layer state collapse without changing the fixed Clay-native FRANK target.

global_negative_receipt: No branch receives a scientific promotion from this run. The executable discriminator is synthetic proxy evidence and target-host BASE acceptance remains open.
